body_lead: BENGALURU: Home Minister Dr G Parameshwara on Wednesday launched a multilingual AI integration in the Namma 112 Emergency Response Support System, marking a first-of-its-kind initiative in India to make emergency services more accessible and inclusive. The initiative, developed in collaboration with Monday Ventures and Acos, aims to eliminate language barriers that often hinder access to emergency assistance in a diverse city.
